message.reasoning_content:
We need to list crimes based on the facts: production and sale of counterfeit drugs (假药). Also possibly illegal business of drug manufacturing without qualification (非法生产假药). Chinese criminal law: "生产、销售假药罪" (罪名: 生产、销售假药罪). Also maybe "非法经营罪"? But the fact is about producing and selling counterfeit drugs. The law: Article 141 of Criminal Law: "生产、销售假药罪". Also "非法经营罪" could apply if selling without license. But the fact says no drug production qualification, using false labeling. The primary crime is "生产、销售假药罪". Also "非法经营药品罪"? There's "非法经营罪" (Article 225) for illegal business of controlled substances. But typical charge is "生产、销售假药罪". Also "诈骗罪"? He got illegal profit, but not deception? He sold fake drugs to hospitals, which is harmful. So just "生产、销售假药罪". Possibly "非法获取国家税收收入罪"? No.

Thus answer: [罪名]生产、销售假药罪<eoa>. Use semicolon if multiple, but only one.
